name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST Twice, StartDate Updated
description: POSTs the same apprenticeship learner (ULN 44444447, standard 21) twice with no ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent in between. The second POST changes OnProgramme StartDate (2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-15) and its cost FromDate to match. CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle finds the draft learning already exists via GetByLearnerKey and merges the resubmission's changed fields via learning.Update(updateModel) — the second POST's StartDate change is applied, still on the same episode (no second episode is created). No approval step — the draft is left unapproved.

steps.name: SLD Re-POSTs the Same Apprenticeship With a Changed StartDate (2026-04-15)

assertions.name: Still only one episode for the learner
Episode StartDate updated to the second POST's value
